newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwong Sang adjourns shareholder meeting.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Sang adjourns shareholder meeting.

text.p: Kwong Sang Hong International Ltd said on Wednesday it would adjourn a shareholders' meeting on its privatisation due to be held today to February 24.
It said notice of the meeting had not been published in English and Chinese language newspapers in Hong Kong as required.
A special general meeting, convened for Wednesday, would also be adjourned, Kwong Sang Hong said in a statement.
Trading in shares Kwong Sang Hong and Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd, which said in December it would privatise Kwong Sang Hong, was suspended on Wednesday.
Kwong Sang Hong said there had been no revision in the terms of the privatisation.
